name_zh: 科伊夫曼-麦金托什-迈耶定理
canonical_claim: The Cauchy singular integral associated with a Lipschitz curve extends to a bounded operator on the corresponding L^2 space, with every curve, measure, principal-value, normalization, and bound convention still to be frozen from the primary source.
domain_and_universes: Open: the source must fix whether a Lipschitz curve is a graph z(t)=t+iA(t), a parametrized curve, or a finite/closed curve; the parameter measure, complex scalar field, and L2 realization must be explicit.
conclusion: Open in exact form: boundedness of a specified principal-value or uniformly truncated Cauchy singular integral on a specified L2 space, including the norm dependence.
excluded_degenerate_cases: Not yet frozen. Constant curves, noninjective parametrizations, zero-length pieces, endpoints, diagonal values, truncation shape, orientation, infinite versus compact parameter domains, and equivalence of arclength and parameter measure require source decisions.
foundation_profile: Lean 4 dependent type theory; classical logic and choice requirements remain open until the singular-integral construction and extension statement are frozen
tcb_profile: Lean kernel 4.29.0 and pinned mathlib are the intended base; exact imports and transitive declaration closure remain open
computation_profile: No numerical quadrature, experiment, oracle, or unchecked principal-value computation receives proof credit; the intended result is analytic
formal_system: Lean 4 + mathlib under the rev-5.6 adapter
freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on primary-source inspection, canonical wording, curve or measure convention, truncation or normalization, Lean target, toolchain, mathlib pin, assurance profile, or validator change; review due date and independent reviewers remain open.
status_boundary: Self-tested planned intake only. The primary paper and headline L2 result are identified and pinned Lean component APIs elaborate, but no exact source theorem or canonical Lean target is frozen.
